title: Talk of scrapping Natural England smacks of a government not joining the dots
summary_full: Environmentalists say abolishing independent body will make it easier for landowners and developers ‘to trash nature’Not just any quango, Natural England is the only public body that exists to legally protect the jewels in the crown of English nature – places increasingly under threat in a country that is overseeing an ongoing and devastating decline in its natural world.Ecologists who work for Natural England are independent, and have the legal duty to scrutinise political decisions and ensure that short-term gallops for growth are not allowed to bulldoze forever rare and declining habitats.
